decisions.statement: The image page's slug is the first word.
The bytes are asked of the pages service rather than read off the checkout.
The file is named for the slug and carries the ending its bytes are.
A path said here is written instead of the file under the home folder.
A slug no image page holds is answered as missing data rather than as a wrong call.
The answer names the path written, so a reader can open that file.

definition: the command bringing an image page's picture to a file on this machine
